description: 20 labeled transcript scenarios for evaluating the Ghost Network Buster hybrid classifier. Covers all 8 ghost_reason types, real confirmations, voicemail, and edge cases. Each scenario notes which classifier path should handle it.

classifier_paths.keyword: Fast-path triggers on literal strings in the lowercased transcript: 'voicemail', '[beep]', 'leave a message', 'not in service', 'disconnected', 'dial tone'
classifier_paths.llm: All other transcripts deferred to Gemini Flash via the structured _CLASSIFICATION_PROMPT

scenarios.description: Disconnected — automated SIT recording
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to verify if Dr. Anita Patel accepts Aetna insurance for behavioral health and is accepting new patients.
[Automated recording: We're sorry, the number you have dialed is not in service. Please check the number and try again.]
scenarios.notes: Literal 'not in service' triggers keyword fast-path before LLM is invoked.

scenarios.description: Disconnected — line rings then explicit disconnect message
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Good morning. I'm calling to confirm whether Dr. Robert Torres is still at this location and accepting Cigna for therapy.
[Line rings 14 times, then: This number has been disconnected. No further information is available.]
scenarios.notes: Literal 'disconnected' in transcript body triggers keyword fast-path.

scenarios.description: Wrong network — practice dropped the carrier 18 months ago
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to verify whether Dr. Simone Barker accepts Blue Cross Blue Shield for outpatient behavioral health and is taking new patients.
Receptionist: We used to take Blue Cross but we dropped them about 18 months ago. We're only in-network with United now.
Agent: Is there any chance you'll be rejoining the BCBS network?
Receptionist: I honestly don't know, that's a decision above my pay grade.
scenarios.notes: No keyword trigger. LLM must infer 'dropped' and 'only in-network with United' means wrong_network for BCBS.

scenarios.description: Wrong network — practice never accepted this carrier
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon. I'm calling to verify if Dr. Chen's practice accepts Aetna for mental health services.
Receptionist: No, we've never been in-network with Aetna. We take Oxford and Cigna only.
Agent: Is Dr. Chen listed in the Aetna directory by any chance?
Receptionist: That might be an old listing. We haven't accepted Aetna for at least five years.
scenarios.notes: LLM must distinguish 'never accepted' from other ghost reasons. Stale directory listing context included.

scenarios.description: Not accepting patients — closed panel with 6-9 month waitlist
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm reaching out to confirm whether your practice is accepting new Aetna patients for anxiety and depression therapy.
Receptionist: Our panel is completely full at the moment. We closed to new patients back in March.
Agent: Is there a waitlist we could join?
Receptionist: We do have a waitlist but it's also quite long — realistically 6 to 9 months out.
scenarios.notes: Provider accepts Aetna and offers BH services but is functionally inaccessible. Extended waitlist still counts as not_accepting.

scenarios.description: Not accepting patients — booked solid, no timeline given
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Good morning. I'm verifying if Dr. Williams is accepting new patients under UnitedHealthcare for behavioral health.
Receptionist: She's not taking anyone new right now. Her schedule is completely booked.
Agent: Any idea when she might open back up?
Receptionist: We just don't know, I'm sorry.
scenarios.notes: Short exchange. LLM must recognize 'not taking anyone new' and 'completely booked' as not_accepting_patients.

scenarios.description: Wrong provider — listed therapist left the practice 2 years ago
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: I'm calling to reach Dr. Felix Huang, a behavioral health therapist listed in the Cigna directory at this number.
Receptionist: Dr. Huang left our practice two years ago. We have no forwarding information for him.
Agent: Do you know where he relocated?
Receptionist: No idea, he just left. This listing in the directory must be outdated.
scenarios.notes: Provider left the practice — directory listing is stale. Removed network-related language that was confusing the LLM into wrong_network.

scenarios.description: Wrong provider — number belongs to an unrelated business
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to verify if Dr. Maria Santos at this number accepts Aetna insurance for behavioral health services.
Person: This is Tony's Dry Cleaning. There's no doctor here — you have the wrong number.
Agent: To confirm — there is no medical practice or Dr. Maria Santos at this number?
Person: Correct, absolutely not. This number belongs to a dry cleaning business.
scenarios.notes: Extreme wrong_provider case — directory number belongs to a non-medical business entirely.

scenarios.description: Retired — provider retired, practice fully closed
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Good morning. I'm calling to verify if Dr. Harold Greene is currently seeing patients and accepting BCBS for therapy.
Receptionist: Dr. Greene retired at the end of last year. The practice has been closed since January.
Agent: Is there anyone else at this location continuing his practice?
Receptionist: No, the office has completely closed. We're just fielding final calls.
scenarios.notes: Practice fully closed post-retirement. LLM must distinguish retired from wrong_provider (provider is gone but reason is retirement, not relocation).

scenarios.description: No behavioral health — gastroenterology practice listed in BH directory
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to confirm whether your practice accepts Aetna for behavioral health and mental health services.
Receptionist: We accept Aetna, yes — but we're a gastroenterology practice. We don't offer any mental health or behavioral health services here.
Agent: Dr. Feldman is listed in Aetna's behavioral health directory.
Receptionist: That has to be a data error. We've never offered those services.
scenarios.notes: Practice IS in-network for Aetna but the wrong specialty category. Classic directory data error — must not be classified as wrong_network.

scenarios.description: Wrong specialty — cardiologist listed in UHC mental health directory
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon. I'm trying to reach a behavioral health provider — Dr. Yuki Tanaka — listed in the UnitedHealthcare mental health directory.
Receptionist: Dr. Tanaka is a cardiologist. This is a cardiology practice.
Agent: Is she listed incorrectly in the UHC behavioral health directory?
Receptionist: It sounds like it. She doesn't treat mental health conditions at all.
scenarios.notes: Distinct from no_behavioral_health: the named provider has a specific wrong specialty (cardiology), not just a wrong practice category.

scenarios.description: Referral only — PCP referral required, not disclosed in directory
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to confirm that Dr. Priya Nair accepts Aetna and is taking new patients for anxiety treatment.
Receptionist: Dr. Nair does accept Aetna and is in-network. However, we only accept patients with a referral from a primary care physician.
Agent: Is that requirement stated in the Aetna online directory?
Receptionist: I'm not sure what the directory says, but that's our policy — referral required, no exceptions.
scenarios.notes: Tricky case: provider IS in-network and IS accepting patients — but the undisclosed referral barrier makes them a ghost listing under MHPAEA parity rules.

scenarios.description: Real — in-network, accepting, care need confirmed
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to verify if your practice accepts Aetna insurance for outpatient therapy and is currently taking new patients.
Receptionist: Yes, we do accept Aetna for behavioral health. And yes, we are accepting new patients right now.
Agent: Are there therapists available who specialize in anxiety and trauma?
Receptionist: We have two therapists with openings who work with anxiety and PTSD. First available is next Tuesday.
scenarios.notes: Unambiguous real: in-network confirmed, accepting new patients confirmed, care need match confirmed, specific date given.

scenarios.description: Real — BCBS, confirmed with 2-week availability
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon. I'm confirming whether Dr. Jordan accepts BCBS for mental health services and has availability for new patients.
Receptionist: Absolutely — Dr. Jordan is in-network with Blue Cross and she does have openings. Next available is in about two weeks.
Agent: Great. Is she seeing patients for depression and anxiety?
Receptionist: Yes, those are her primary areas.
scenarios.notes: Real with 2-week wait. LLM must not misclassify short wait as not_accepting_patients — two weeks is accessible.

scenarios.description: Real — trauma-certified provider, same-week opening
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm verifying if your practice accepts Cigna for behavioral health and has availability for someone seeking trauma-focused therapy.
Receptionist: Yes, we take Cigna. We actually have a therapist who just had a cancellation and is available as early as this Thursday.
Agent: And they can work with trauma and PTSD patients?
Receptionist: Yes, two of our providers are trauma-certified. Both are currently accepting new Cigna patients.
scenarios.notes: Strong real signal with care need confirmation (trauma/PTSD) and immediate availability.

scenarios.description: Voicemail — explicit greeting with beep
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to verify if Dr. Angela Brooks accepts Aetna for behavioral health and is accepting new patients.
[Automated voice: You have reached the voicemail of Dr. Angela Brooks. Please leave a message after the tone and she will return your call within 48 hours.]
[beep]
scenarios.notes: Both 'voicemail' and '[beep]' trigger keyword fast-path. No LLM call needed.

scenarios.description: Voicemail — office closed, leave a message
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Good morning. Calling to confirm if this practice accepts UnitedHealthcare for therapy services and is taking new patients.
[Recording: Thank you for calling Eastside Counseling. Our office is currently closed. Please leave a message and we will return your call within one business day.]
scenarios.notes: 'Leave a message' triggers keyword fast-path. No human responded — no insurance or availability confirmation possible.

scenarios.description: No answer — call drops mid-sentence
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to verify whether your practice accepts Aetna for behavioral health—
[Call drops mid-sentence]
scenarios.notes: No keyword trigger. LLM receives truncated transcript with no outcome signal — should return no_answer, not ghost.

scenarios.description: STT carrier name garbling — 'eight now' instead of 'Aetna'
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to verify if your practice accepts eight now insurance for behavioral health and is taking new patients.
Receptionist: Eight now? Oh, you mean Aetna? Yes, we do take Aetna. And we are taking new patients right now.
Agent: Perfect, can you confirm that covers behavioral health?
Receptionist: Yes, Aetna covers our full range of therapy services.
scenarios.notes: Tests LLM robustness to Deepgram STT errors. The classification prompt explicitly warns: 'carrier name may be garbled (e.g. eight now instead of Aetna)'. Outcome is still real.

scenarios.description: Ambiguous — long hold, call disconnects with no substantive response
scenarios.transcript:
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to verify if Dr. Thompson accepts Blue Cross for behavioral health.
Person: Uh... hold on... [extended hold music] ... [hold music continues] ... [call disconnects after 4 minutes on hold]
scenarios.notes: No keyword trigger — 'disconnected' does not appear as a literal word; it is a narrative description. LLM receives an ambiguous transcript with no confirmation either way and should return no_answer, not ghost/disconnected.
